label: Betterness varies within an end-realization class
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for some variation scenario s and candidates x, y, at least one not a present input at s, x is better than y at s, and at some scenario that agrees with s on end-realization x is not better than y. It is good-generality of the betterness standard itself (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 applied to the standard as a profile). Its denial, that betterness factors through end-realization, makes nothing good-general on any side and is one of the four members of the #2172 variationCore. It does not say which scenarios are metaphysically possible; on the control carrier the witness is cBetter against actual.
